perspective.title: Perspective
perspective.cursorRaysTitle: With the brush, thin lines from the pointer to the vanishing points (shown even when guides are hidden)
perspective.centerPointTitle: Moves the selected point to the page centre; with nothing selected, arranges the setup around the centre (horizon through the centre, points symmetric)
perspective.hintAdd: Click the canvas to add a vanishing point. It can sit outside the paper too.
perspective.hintEdit: Drag points or the horizon to move them. Press Delete to remove the selected point.
perspective.hintOtherTool: Select the vanishing point tool (P) to edit points.
brush.title: Brush
snap.hint: With the magnet on, lines lock to vanishing points and verticals. Hold Alt to draw freely for a moment.
document.clearConfirm: Delete all lines? Vanishing points are kept. You can undo with Ctrl+Z.
output.printHint: For actual size, set scale to 100% and margins to "None" in the print dialog. Your printer may not reach the last few millimetres of the sheet.
language.label: Language
stage.description: Drag with the mouse to draw. Press S for shapes and V to select and edit; move the selected shape with the arrow keys. Press ? for keyboard shortcuts.
help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.eraser: Eraser; when active, switches the kind (segment / whole line / partial)
help.shape: Shape; when active, switches the kind (line, rectangle, triangle, polygon)
help.select: Select / edit: click a shape, drag a corner or the shape
help.alt: Hold to draw freely (magnet, axis and grid snapping temporarily off)
help.ctrlWheel: Zoom at the cursor (pinch on a touchpad)
toast.saved: Your work is saved in the browser
onboarding.textTouch: Draw towards the vanishing points and your line straightens itself. Tap with two fingers to undo, three to redo.
help.delete: Delete the selected shape or vanishing point
help.arrows: Move the selected shape (Shift: 10×; one cell with grid snapping on)
help.polygon: Finish polygon · remove last corner · cancel
help.rotate: Rotate the view (Shift: 15° steps); rotate with two fingers on touch
project.title: Project file
project.hint: Save the drawing with its vanishing points and paper settings to a file, then open it in another browser or on another computer. You can also open a file by dropping it onto the canvas.
project.invalid: Couldn't read the file, or it isn't a Perspektif project file.
project.replaceConfirm: The opened file will replace the current drawing. You can undo with Ctrl+Z. Continue?
templates.title: Templates
templates.hint: A template places the vanishing points and draws light gray guide lines for you to trace. It replaces the current drawing; you can undo with Ctrl+Z.
templates.replaceConfirm: The template will replace the current drawing. You can undo with Ctrl+Z. Continue?
template.cube.name: Cube
template.road.name: Road

template.room-corner.name: Room corner

onboarding.text: Draw towards the vanishing points and your line straightens itself. S for shapes, hold Alt to draw freely, Space to pan.
tutorial.waiting: Try it and the tour moves on by itself.
tutorial.sandboxConfirm: The tour runs on a blank page. Your drawing is kept and comes back when the tour ends.
tutorial.recovered: Your drawing from before the unfinished tour is back
tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome
tutorial.welcome.text: Perspektif helps you draw clean perspective lines by leaning on vanishing points. Let's try the basics in a quick tour (2 minutes).
tutorial.welcome.textTouch: Perspektif helps you draw clean perspective lines by leaning on vanishing points. Let's try the basics in a quick tour (2 minutes).
tutorial.points.title: Vanishing points
tutorial.points.text: The blue and green rings on the horizon are vanishing points. Hover one, then drag it.
tutorial.points.textTouch: The blue and green rings on the horizon are vanishing points. Touch one and drag it.
tutorial.rays.title: Ghost rays
tutorial.rays.text: Move the pointer near a vanishing point: its rays get stronger. Your lines will lock onto these rays.
tutorial.rays.textTouch: The faint lines from the points are ghost rays. Your lines will lock onto them.
tutorial.line.title: Magnetic line
tutorial.line.text: With the brush, draw a rough line towards a vanishing point: it straightens itself onto the ray. Hold Alt to draw freely.
tutorial.line.textTouch: With the brush, draw a rough line towards a vanishing point: it straightens itself onto the ray.
tutorial.shape.title: Shapes and boxes
tutorial.shape.text: Draw a rectangle with the shape tool (S). Dashed lines run from its corners to the vanishing points; select it (V) and use "Make a box".
tutorial.shape.textTouch: Draw a rectangle with the shape tool. Dashed lines run from its corners to the vanishing points; select it and use "Make a box".
tutorial.erase.title: Segment eraser
tutorial.erase.text: Touch part of a line with the eraser: only the piece between crossings goes. Oops? Ctrl+Z undoes it.
tutorial.erase.textTouch: Touch part of a line with the eraser: only the piece between crossings goes. A two-finger tap undoes it.
tutorial.view.title: Move around
tutorial.view.text: Hold Space and drag to pan, Ctrl + wheel to zoom, hold R and drag to turn the page. Try one.
tutorial.view.textTouch: Pan with two fingers, pinch to zoom, twist to turn the page. Try one.
tutorial.done.title: Save and share
tutorial.done.text: Your work is saved in the browser automatically. Use the download button for PNG or SVG and the printer for an A4 print. All shortcuts are under ?. Happy drawing!
tutorial.done.textTouch: Your work is saved in the browser automatically. Download PNG or SVG or print from the ⋯ menu. Happy drawing!
eraser.title: Eraser
eraser.hintStroke: Any line you touch is removed entirely. Press E again to switch type.
eraser.hintPixel: Only the part under the eraser is removed; the line is split into pieces. Press E again to switch type.
eraser.hintSegment: Only the part you touch is erased: between the points where it crosses (or touches) other lines. A line with no crossings is erased whole. Press E again to switch the kind.
layers.title: Layers
layers.deleteConfirm: Delete the layer "{name}" and everything on it? You can undo with Ctrl+Z.
layers.nameHint: Click: make active · Double-click or F2: rename
layers.blockedLocked: The active layer is locked; unlock it or pick another layer to draw.
layers.blockedHidden: The active layer is hidden; show it or pick another layer to draw.
layers.limit: There can be at most {n} layers.
shape.title: Shape
shape.hint.segment: Drag to draw a line segment. It snaps to vanishing point rays, axes and the grid. Press S again to switch the kind.
shape.hint.rect: Drag from one corner to the opposite one. Corners snap to the grid. Press S again to switch the kind.
shape.hint.triangle: Drag to draw a triangle that fits the box; you can edit its corners later. Press S again to switch the kind.
shape.hint.polygon: Click corner by corner. Click the first corner, double-click or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last corner, Esc cancels.
select.title: Select / edit
select.hintBox: Drag a back corner to change the depth, a front corner to change the front face; drag an edge to move the box. The box follows when its vanishing point moves.
box.convertTitle: Uses a rectangle as the front face towards one vanishing point, or a vertical line segment as the front edge towards the two horizon points
select.toStrokesTitle: Turns the shape into plain lines that can no longer be edited (visible edges; a box's back edges only with "Visible")
select.hintBox2: Drag a side corner to change the depth in that direction, the back corner to change both, the ends of the front edge to change the height. The box follows when its vanishing points move.
select.hintEmpty: Click the outline of a shape to edit it.
select.hintSelected: Drag a corner handle to move the corner (a rectangle keeps its opposite corner), drag an edge to move the shape. Delete removes it, Esc deselects.
grid.title: Perspective grid
grid.hint: Adds a light gray grid that follows your vanishing points, with squares that shorten correctly in perspective. It's added to the current drawing; you can undo with Ctrl+Z.
grid.needPoints: The grid needs all vanishing points of the setup. In 3-point, the three points must form an acute triangle (vertical point far enough from the horizon).
paperGrid.title: Paper grid
paperGrid.hint: Straight lines start on grid points and end on grid lines. Show off, snap on: an invisible ruler. The grid is included in "with guides" output.
reference.title: Reference image
reference.hint: Load a photo to draw over, or drop it onto the canvas. It isn't included in exports or the project file.
perspective.hintVertical: Drag the vertical vanishing point below the horizon (bird's-eye) or above it (worm's-eye); vertical lines converge there.
help.touch: One finger draws (pans once a pen has been used); two fingers pan, zoom and rotate; two-finger tap: undo, three-finger tap: redo
corners.label: Corner lines
corners.allTitle: From shape corners to every vanishing point
corners.oneTitle: From shape corners to the vanishing point you choose
perspective.hintOff: Perspective is off: draw in any direction. With straight lines on, each line runs straight from start to end; snap to axes levels it horizontally/vertically (hold Alt to skip). Your setup is kept and comes back when you switch to 1, 2 or 3.
